title: Proposed fixes for the money helpers

questions.question: I'd make these four changes to `src/utils/money.ts`. Decide on each one.

items.label: Fix the sign of small negative amounts
items.preview:
```diff
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@ export function toCents(dollars: string): number {
 export function fromCents(cents: number): string {
-  const dollars = Math.trunc(cents / 100)
-  const rest = Math.abs(cents % 100).toString().padStart(2, '0')
-  return `$${dollars}.${rest}`
+  const sign = cents < 0 ? '-' : ''
+  const dollars = Math.trunc(Math.abs(cents) / 100)
+  const rest = (Math.abs(cents) % 100).toString().padStart(2, '0')
+  return `${sign}$${dollars}.${rest}`
 }
```

items.label: Round toCents half-even
items.preview:
```diff
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 export function toCents(dollars: string): number {
-  return Math.round(Number(dollars) * 100)
+  return roundHalfEven(Number(dollars) * 100)
 }
```

items.label: Reject non-numeric input
items.preview:
```diff
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
 export function toCents(dollars: string): number {
-  return Math.round(Number(dollars) * 100)
+  const value = Number(dollars)
+  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error(`not an amount: ${dollars}`)
+  return Math.round(value * 100)
 }
```

items.label: Add thousands separators
items.preview:
```diff
@@ -8,3 +8,4 @@ export function fromCents(cents: number): string {
-  return `${sign}$${dollars}.${rest}`
+  const grouped = dollars.toLocaleString('en-US')
+  return `${sign}$${grouped}.${rest}`
 }
```
